name: Battle scene
description: The workhorse: two armies of chosen factions drawn up in a painted landscape, advancing through haze; on the key word the action fires (musket volley, bayonet charge, cannonade, advance, clash). Cannons, waving colours, drifting smoke, a slow camera push into the attacker. Optional cream banner headline and a place/date lower-third. Use for most scenes that describe fighting or armies facing each other.

faction.description: Army preset: redcoat (British line, red coats), bluecoat (Napoleonic French), whitecoat (Austrian / Bourbon), greencoat (Russian / riflemen), prussian (dark blue, spiked helmets), union (US Civil War federal), continental (American Revolution), musketeer (17th-century pike and shot), roman (legionaries with scutum), hoplite (Greek phalanx), knight (medieval men-at-arms), samurai (Sengoku Japan), viking (shield wall), mongol (steppe horse archers), ottoman (janissaries). A free-text nation name is also mapped to the nearest preset.

name: Council of war
description: Commanders around a candle-lit map table inside a tent or hall: one speaks and points at the map while the others listen and nod; candles flicker; the camera pushes from the room to the map. The decision lands as a cream banner on the key word. Use for plans, orders, arguments and turning-point decisions.

name: Battle map
description: Top-down tactical map on aged parchment: rivers, forests, hills and towns inked in; coloured unit blocks for each side; on the key word thick manoeuvre arrows sweep across the map (frontal assault, flank, pincer, feigned retreat, envelopment, breakthrough, defence) and the units move along them to a clash burst. Compass, scale bar, optional banner. Use to explain tactics and movements.
